timing_methodology.search_time_ms: core search: from after per-cell arrays are allocated and initialised to the end of path reconstruction (frontier growth included)
timing_methodology.end_to_end_time_ms: one complete search call: allocation, initialisation, search, path reconstruction and freeing of the per-cell arrays
timing_methodology.measurement: both values come from the same call; one fresh call per timed run
timing_methodology.excluded: grid generation, reference validation, rendering, progress output, CSV writing
timing_methodology.run_order: interleaved; algorithm order rotated by run index

configuration.seed_rule: grid i uses seed base_seed + i
configuration.rng_streams: obstacles: seed; endpoints: splitmix64-derived stream 1; terrain: stream 2

validation.oracle: independent reachability BFS and Dial bucket-queue minimum cost (validation.cpp)
